findings.description: holidays() used to memoize per year. It now calls self._source.holidays(...) every time. JsonHolidaySource re-reads and re-parses the whole JSON file on each call. is_business_day runs once per day in add_business_days, roll_forward and business_days_between, and SlaPolicy calls these for every ticket. A single due-date calculation therefore does many file reads and JSON parses, and overdue() over many tickets multiplies that.
findings.suggestion: Restore a per-year cache inside BusinessCalendar, for example a dict keyed by year. CalendarSet already holds one calendar per region, so the cache stays per region.
findings.title: Per-year holiday cache removed; source is queried on every is_business_day call
